source_title: What Do I Need To Know About My 1099 K Tax Form
source_date_if_available: No date found. URL returned 403; content verified via search engine index.

snippets.snippet_text: "If you're not a US seller, you won't be issued a 1099-K from Etsy. However, if the information on your Legal and tax information page identifies you as a US seller (your address on file is US or you receive payments in USD), we're required to issue you a 1099-K form. To remove yourself or your business from this filing obligation, we'll need a completed W-8BEN form. To start the W-8 form request, contact Etsy support."
